recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Do not reapply the FHIR-32719 CodeableReference model to the current build unless the work group explicitly revisits the later FHIR-50894/FHIR-53025 decision chain.
issue_request: FHIR-32719 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 Imaging Integration request to replace the former ImagingStudy.procedure backbone with a 0..* CodeableReference so performed procedure information could be expressed as a reference or code.
initial_application: Commit 52a5df179457fea03c4c8e598133c470f4e1de38 applied the seed by changing ImagingStudy.procedure from a BackboneElement/procedure.value[x] structure to CodeableReference and by adjusting the binding. FHIR-38673 later refined the R5 CodeableReference target from Procedure to PlanDefinition/ActivityDefinition.
additional_context: Applied R6 issue FHIR-50894 removed the CodeableReference procedure element and moved performed-procedure semantics to ImagingStudy.partOf. Applied R6 issue FHIR-53025 then reversed that partOf approach and explicitly required ImagingStudy.procedure as Reference(Procedure). The combined branch already contains the FHIR-53025 reconciliation commit 4f90e4dc1fc78b042d2991d0bcb589aeefed760e.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current active source defines ImagingStudy.procedure as 0..* Reference(Procedure), keeps the procedure search parameter on ImagingStudy.procedure, and uses Procedure/example in the XR example; targeted searches found no stale ImagingStudy.procedure CodeableReference/value/concept remnants in source/imagingstudy.
